module_unreachable.title: Viega module {device} is not reachable
module_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has received no response from the Viega Fonterra module **{device}** since {since}. Room values stay at their last known state until it responds again.

Check that the module is powered and connected to the network. The integration keeps reconnecting on its own, and this message disappears automatically once the module responds again.

base_unit_error_3.title: Viega module {device}: A room thermostat is no longer connected
base_unit_error_3.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: At least one room thermostat is no longer connected to the base unit.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_4.title: Viega module {device}: Fault on the actuator bus
base_unit_error_4.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: There is a fault on the actuator bus.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_5.title: Viega module {device}: Flow-temperature sensor fault
base_unit_error_5.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: The flow-temperature sensor reports a fault.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_6.title: Viega module {device}: Return-temperature sensor fault
base_unit_error_6.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: The return-temperature sensor reports a fault.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_7.title: Viega module {device}: No more room thermostats can be registered
base_unit_error_7.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: No further room thermostats can be registered at the base unit.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_9.title: Viega module {device}: Replace the backup battery
base_unit_error_9.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: The backup battery of the base unit needs to be replaced.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_10.title: Viega module {device}: Risk of condensation
base_unit_error_10.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: Warning: risk of condensation because the flow temperature is too low.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_21.title: Viega module {device}: No connection to a room thermostat
base_unit_error_21.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: There is no connection to a room thermostat.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_22.title: Viega module {device}: Room thermostat battery is weak
base_unit_error_22.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: Warning: the battery of a room thermostat is weak.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_24.title: Viega module {device}: Weak connection to a room thermostat
base_unit_error_24.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: Warning: the connection to a room thermostat is weak.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

base_unit_error_unknown.title: Viega module {device}: error code {code}
base_unit_error_unknown.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}, which is not described in the Viega manual known to this integration.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.

registers_not_updating.title: Viega module {device}: values are not updating

enable_modbus.title: Fonterra found. Enable Modbus TCP
enable_modbus.description: Fonterra at **{host}** announced its web service, but Modbus did not respond. Open the Fonterra settings and check that **Modbus TCP** is enabled to add the hub.
